verdict.rationale: Evidence clearly documents a Python SDK (galileo-python GitHub repo, @log decorator, cookbooks using Galileo's Python SDK) and OTel-based distributed tracing that could work across languages, but there is no explicit mention of an officially supported JS/TS SDK anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: JS/TS SDK documentation or repo, JS/TS-specific instrumentation examples, confirmation of parity between Python and JS/TS SDKs.
